name: DAVIS (Densely Annotated Video Segmentation)
description: A video object segmentation benchmark providing densely annotated videos and pixel-level object masks for evaluating video object segmentation methods. This record is metadata-only and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Perazzi, F., Pont-Tuset, J., McWilliams, B., Van Gool, L., Gross, M., & Sorkine-Hornung, A. (2016). A Benchmark Dataset and Evaluation Methodology for Video Object Segmentation. Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 724–732. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2016.85
